tasks.brief: Fix the delivery strand found by the J-1 diagnostic (verify1065/diag1065.mjs): after the hut is done, a founder who flips to rest/eat while carrying wood strands the delivery — Greta and Perrin carried 2 wood each for 115+ seconds without delivering (completed stuck at 17, pile stuck at 14). Root cause: the delivery branch and founderDestination are gated on activity being work/build — a resting/eating carrier walks to the rest/eat tile, not the stockpile, and the delivery never fires. Fix: make delivery execute by workState, not activity (a carrying founder heads to the camp centre and delivers regardless of activity). It is self-limiting and does not block the hut chain or 0x06. Verify with a diagnostic that a carrying founder who flips to rest/eat still delivers within a bounded time.
